name: tksfw
description: TKS framework tooling: ledger-aware hooks (state injection, edit hashing, YAML ledger validation) and the Group-A skills (yaml-log-entry, register-deliverables, verify-integrity, verify-sources).

interface.shortDescription: Method hooks and skills for AGENTS.md-driven projects
interface.longDescription: Installs the TKS framework tooling once per user: SessionStart state injection, hash-based edit tracking, YAML ledger validation on write, Stop-time ledger reminders, and the framework skills. The method text (AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.local.md, .agents/workarea/, .codex/config.toml) is created per project from the TKSfw template.
